revision_rationale: Post-result development: ordinary no-eviction fast path and capture omission separated from native failure windows. Original v1 receipts preserved; not held-out validation.
clock: authored producer/audit ordering ticks; actual synchronous response latency against fixed development budgets, not operator SLA
audit_service: recover request-scoped input/output identity, effective session dependency and execution closure certificate; verdict-only native history is credited separately, not called the same witness service
measurement_contract: all policies share one captured producer stream; per-policy archive components, secondary tier costs and whole-process RAM measured separately; no summed overlapping timers or per-policy serving speedup
capacity_rationale: prospectively fixed 4/16/64KiB development quotas plus provisioned reference; not operator limits or production SLO
demand_rationale: error and fixed periodic compatibility check inspect preceding request window; authored incident-grounded service, not observed operator demand

forecasts.graph_only: insufficient for effective initializer identity across legal SessionOptions overrides
forecasts.complete_session_join: source history and complete captured session/request join suffice under trusted fixed CPU workflow
forecasts.missing_capture: retention and refetch of equally incomplete evidence cannot restore uncaptured association
forecasts.late_demand: pinning cannot resurrect discarded history without an explicitly retained recovery source
forecasts.native_failure: preserve native failure and unknown model-use verdict; not fulfilled conclusive audit
forecasts.repair: retain complete session initializer dependency; do not remove legitimate override behavior

transfer_nomination.status: historical nomination; serialization qualification executed separately without inference; not model-use validation
